_source: In-client «ЗМІНИТИ ТИТУЛУВАННЯ» screen, transcribed 2026-08-13. These are OFFICIAL in-game values, unlike the emblem coefficients which remain reverse-engineered.
_model: A title is prefix + suffix. Both are per-GAME conditional multipliers, not banner-level constants — which is why the observed uplift differs per role and is exactly 1.0 when nothing qualifies. The title applies to the emblem SUM of the role, per counted map.

prefixes.conditionUk: у грі за жовтого чи коричневого героя
у грі за водного, вогняного чи льодяного героя
у грі за немертвого, демона чи духа
у грі за героя із плащем чи маскою

_prefixNote: EVERY prefix needs a hero->colour/trait pool that we do not have. The spec calls for extracting it from the Dota 2 client VPK (open item 6). Until then no prefix is computable, and a banner whose uplift depends on one cannot be fully reproduced.

suffixes.conditionUk: якщо хтось із гравців помре від мучителя
suffixes.note: combat log DEATH with attacker npc_dota_miniboss. Not in any API; we already parse the replays.

suffixes.conditionUk: якщо хтось із гравців проллє першу кров до звуку сурми
suffixes.note: first blood objective time < 0 (the horn is t=0, creeps spawn).

suffixes.conditionUk: якщо першу кров не пролито до 10 хвилини
suffixes.note: first blood time >= 600s, or no first blood at all.

suffixes.conditionUk: в іграх, які тривають менше ніж 25 хвилин

suffixes.note: game 3 of a Bo3 / game 5 of a Bo5. NOT merely the last game PLAYED — a 2-0 sweep never reaches the last possible game, so this never fires for it.
Which digit? Seconds ending in 8, or the displayed MM:SS last digit. Both are derivable from duration; the reading is the unknown.

suffixes.conditionUk: якщо гравця вбито на власному фонтані
suffixes.note: Fountain kills. Marked out of scope by the user; the spec also flags it uncomputable.

_stacking: Unresolved. Whether prefix and suffix add (1 + p + s) or multiply ((1+p)(1+s)) on a qualifying game is not yet determined; no observed banner has had both fire on a known map.
